whenToUse: The frame of every admin app (CMS, CRM, HR, ops): sidebar, top bar, content, ⌘K palette and toasts.
Multi-app products that share one navigation definition.
Start every panel screen from a shell-* block, which wires AppShell for you.
avoidWhen: Public websites — use Navbar and Footer site blocks.
Full-screen focused flows like sign-in or onboarding wizards.
a11y: Includes a skip link and a single main landmark; keep one h1 per page inside the content.
Mobile navigation opens as a sheet with focus trapped and restored.
